How does LBL handle review responses for dental practices?

Every 4 and 5-star review gets a professional reply within 1 hour. When a patient mentions a specific procedure — Invisalign, implants, cleaning, whitening — we reference it in the response. This reinforces your keyword ranking for that service. For negative reviews, we send you a draft for approval before anything posts.
Does the content follow dental marketing regulations?

Yes. We write all dental content conservatively — no medical claims, no guarantees, no before/after language without documented consent. We use experiential and educational framing throughout. "We helped relieve discomfort" rather than "We fix TMJ." Your posts stay within safe limits for professional healthcare marketing.
What kind of posts perform best for dental GBPs?

Educational content consistently outperforms promotional posts in dental — oral hygiene tips, what to expect from specific procedures, seasonal reminders (back-to-school exams, holiday diet tips). We post Monday, Wednesday, Friday at 9 AM with AI-generated images. Topics never repeat within 30 days.
Can LBL help a practice recover from negative reviews?

We handle professional, empathetic responses to existing negative reviews and monitor for new ones. The fastest path to rating recovery is a combination of good responses and new positive reviews. We take care of the response side — your team handles patient follow-up for new review requests. Most practices see measurable improvement within 60 days.
